paper_title: Sound of Dark Matter: Searching for Light Scalars with Resonant-Mass Detectors
notes: Paper proposes resonant-mass detectors to probe scalar DM moduli coupling to electron mass (d_me) and electromagnetic gauge (d_e). Constrains both ScalarElectron (d_me) and ScalarPhoton (d_e). Main results are projected SNR=1 reaches (Cu-Si sphere, AURIGA recast, DUAL, quartz) shown in Fig. 1 as curves; only an existing Earth seismology bound |de+dme| < 2.5e-4 at f~8.1e-4 Hz (m~3.4e-18 eV) is given numerically. No tabulated data points available for the coupling-vs-mass curves; values would require reading off a log-log plot with two overlaid couplings. Given ambiguity between ScalarElectron and ScalarPhoton and lack of extractable numerical curve data, confidence is low. | [VISION GATE A] is_projection=true but the vision notes say the traced curve is existing exclusion — not the paper's own projected curve
